chapter: Childhood in Tyler, Beaumont and Houston
title: Glee Club and his Houston high schools
summary: He sang in the Glee Club, and describes Gregory, Booker T. Washington and Jack Yates schools, where he also took music lessons.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

Sure, I was with the Ambassadors.

Well, it used to be nice. It's pretty good for calling fish or anything.
